results.title: Build your deck. Keep it local.
results.body: An offline presentation editor for developers, with editable text and local copies.
items: Keep slide text editable as your ideas change.
Save local copies for review and reuse.
results.notes: Build presentations offline while keeping control of the content. Edit the text as your ideas develop, then save local copies you can review and reuse.

results.title: 本地优先，从大纲到副本
results.body: 在本地整理内容、检查版式并导出，让文字保持可编辑。
items: 整理大纲：用 JSON 组织内容。
检查排版：在本地 HTML 中预览。
导出副本：保存可编辑的 PowerPoint。
results.notes: 先用 JSON 整理大纲，再在本地 HTML 中检查排版，最后导出可编辑的 PowerPoint 副本。整个流程围绕本地文件展开，方便继续修改和保存。

results.title: A local star, an editable caption
results.body: Plan an original abstract star illustration stored locally, paired with an editable caption.
items: Place the local star illustration beside the caption.
Caption: A small spark for your next idea.
results.notes: Use an original local illustration of a star formed from overlapping angular shapes. It provides decoration, not scientific evidence. Keep the caption editable. If the image is unavailable, show the text fallback. No image is generated or fetched for this plan.
results.alt: Abstract star formed from overlapping angular shapes.
results.fallback: Display editable text: “A small spark for your next idea.”

results.title: Choose your presentation route
results.body: Explore locally in HTML or use a static, editable PowerPoint. Keep all labels and content editable.
items: Local HTML: explore content through tabs.
Editable PowerPoint: present content as static slides.
results.notes: Use the two tabs to compare the routes. Local HTML supports exploration, while editable PowerPoint provides a static presentation. Keep every word as editable text, including tab labels. The static fallback shows both choices together with their labels.
results.fallback: Show both labeled choices side by side as editable text.

results.title: Clamp the next index to valid bounds
results.body: Handle empty counts first, then advance and clamp the result to 0..count-1.
items: Return 0 when count is zero or negative.
results.notes: The original upper bound allowed count, which is outside the valid index range. Return 0 for count<=0; otherwise clamp index+1 between 0 and count-1. For positive integer counts, -1 advances to 0, 0 advances when another index exists, and the last index stays in place.
